## ⚠️ Arms that required LOCAL REPAIRS to their upstream dependency

**The released streaming path of these dependencies DOES NOT EXECUTE AS-IS.** The study's strongest new claim on such an arm rests on code that was locally repaired here, and that has to be on the face of the deliverable, not only in an amendment.

**`melflow`** — 2 structural repairs to upstream revision `ab2700c1`:

1. streaming_unet.py:899 - CausalConv2d.forward_step reads `self.depthwise_separable` and `self.pointwise_conv`; CausalConv2d.__init__ defines NEITHER (they belong to the separate CausalDecoupledConv2d compression class). Every forward_step call raises AttributeError on an uncompressed model. Defaulted to False, the only value consistent with a class that has no pointwise conv.
2. streaming_unet.py:665/683 - CausalResnetBlockBigGANpp.init_state returns a 5-tuple while its own forward_step unpacks 6 (`state_se`), so the block raises ValueError on the first call. `state_se` is unpacked and repacked and never read or written anywhere in the body - a leftover slot for a squeeze-excite branch this class does not have. A sixth element None is appended. No weights or arithmetic changed.

**An independent delta audit verified both patches are INERT**: it confirmed that neither referenced attribute exists anywhere in the class, that the non-streaming `forward()` path has no pointwise branch (so `False` is the only value making `forward_step` agree with `forward`), that `state_se` occurs at exactly two lines — the unpack and the repack — and is never read or written, and that **no weight and no arithmetic operation is touched by either.**

⛔ **The untested stage on this arm is not free.** A control from the independent delta audit, 2026-09-11 — naive split-in-two inverse STFT of the assembled spectrogram, then concatenate, versus one inverse STFT over the whole spectrogram — measured **raw 1.03611 / 134.65%**, 256 samples short (253440 vs 253696). *(Externally sourced; reproduced in this harness: False.)* the overlap-add stage is NOT free. Streaming it does not follow from the neural decoder streaming, so it may not be inferred (R13). Earning an unqualified TRUE_INCREMENTAL for this arm requires writing and TESTING a streaming overlap-add stage.

## Negative controls — the rows that make the positives mean something

`toks_to_sig(..., decompressor_state, decoder_state, return_state=True)` is the SAME method on every FocalCodec config, so the non-causal configs are run through the identical stateful branch. **If carrying state changes nothing on a non-causal config, C2 lands at ~1.0 — and that is the evidence that the harness's state plumbing is not manufacturing the passes on the causal configs.** Had a negative control passed, the experiment would be void rather than the arm promoted.

## Chunked-decode length drift — measured, not assumed

Per-chunk output length `L(u)` is fitted against chunk size `u` as `L(u) = a·u + b`. **The fit is EXACT (residual 0.0) for 18 of 18 fitted arms**, so for those `b` is the constant offset every chunk carries and it accumulates once per chunk. `n = min(lengths)` hides it, which is why part of the reported error on the arms with `b ≠ 0` is misalignment rather than boundary damage.

**Arms that drift:** `dualcodec_12hz_v1` **b = -4** · `dualcodec_25hz_v1` **b = -4** · `vocos_mel24` **b = -256** · `griffinlim` **b = -256**. Every other exactly-fitted arm has **b = 0**.

⚠️ **`melflow` is absent from the drift table by declaration, not by omission.** NOT APPLICABLE. The per-chunk length model does not fit this arm exactly (residual 0.093), because its decoder emits spectrogram frames and the inverse STFT is run once over the assembled spectrogram. There is no per-chunk length accumulation to measure (2026-09-11 delta-audit correction).

## The instrument was fuzzed before it was trusted

`fuzz_gate_lib.py` attacks the shared Gate Zero record, the error metric, the classifier, the chunk-grid function and the layout resolver — outputs a decoder could plausibly produce, and label combinations that must not earn `TRUE_INCREMENTAL`. Results in `fuzz_gate_lib.json`. **It found one latent defect in `native_grid` (Python's banker's rounding: `round(0.5) == 0`), which was fixed; no arm's grid was affected, verified condition by condition against the exact frame period each run used.** ⛔ The instrument SURVIVED these attacks. It is not closed, and its author is not its certifier (R19).

## Per-arm state findings — read from the artifacts

**`focalcodec_50hz_4k_causal`** — toks_to_sig(..., decompressor_state, decoder_state, return_state=True) accepts and returns decode state on EVERY FocalCodec config. Whether that state is load-bearing is what C2 measures; this config is causal=True.

**`focalcodec_50hz_2k_causal`** — toks_to_sig(..., decompressor_state, decoder_state, return_state=True) accepts and returns decode state on EVERY FocalCodec config. Whether that state is load-bearing is what C2 measures; this config is causal=True.

**`focalcodec_50hz_65k_causal`** — toks_to_sig(..., decompressor_state, decoder_state, return_state=True) accepts and returns decode state on EVERY FocalCodec config. Whether that state is load-bearing is what C2 measures; this config is causal=True.

**`focalcodec_50hz`** — toks_to_sig(..., decompressor_state, decoder_state, return_state=True) accepts and returns decode state on EVERY FocalCodec config. Whether that state is load-bearing is what C2 measures; this config is causal=False.

**`focalcodec_25hz`** — toks_to_sig(..., decompressor_state, decoder_state, return_state=True) accepts and returns decode state on EVERY FocalCodec config. Whether that state is load-bearing is what C2 measures; this config is causal=False.

**`focalcodec_12_5hz`** — toks_to_sig(..., decompressor_state, decoder_state, return_state=True) accepts and returns decode state on EVERY FocalCodec config. Whether that state is load-bearing is what C2 measures; this config is causal=False.

**`mimi_q8`** — MimiDecoderOutput carries BOTH `audio_values` and `decoder_past_key_values`. decode() has no use_cache argument; the cache is gated by config.use_cache, shipped as False by kyutai/mimi. With it enabled decode() returns a live DynamicCache and carrying it changes the output. What is missing is the CONVOLUTIONAL padding cache: MimiConv1d.forward(hidden_states, padding_cache=None) is never threaded through MimiModel.decode(), and decode() accepts neither `padding_cache` nor `use_streaming` while encode() accepts both.

**`mimi_q32`** — MimiDecoderOutput carries BOTH `audio_values` and `decoder_past_key_values`. decode() has no use_cache argument; the cache is gated by config.use_cache, shipped as False by kyutai/mimi. With it enabled decode() returns a live DynamicCache and carrying it changes the output. What is missing is the CONVOLUTIONAL padding cache: MimiConv1d.forward(hidden_states, padding_cache=None) is never threaded through MimiModel.decode(), and decode() accepts neither `padding_cache` nor `use_streaming` while encode() accepts both.

**`encodec24_q8`** — decode('audio_codes', 'audio_scales', 'padding_mask', 'return_dict', 'last_frame_pad_length') carries no state parameter of any kind; config sets chunk_length_s=None and overlap=None, so this checkpoint defines no chunked operating mode. use_causal_conv=True is architectural evidence only and is not promoted to a capability (R13).

**`encodec_vocos`** — ConvNeXt backbone with centre padding plus an iSTFT head; the adapter and both submodules take a feature tensor and no state

**`dac44`** — decoder uses symmetric padding and exposes no decode state; the module offers no causal option

**`dualcodec_12hz_v1`** — Inference.decode('semantic_codes', 'acoustic_codes') carries no state parameter; the module exposes decode / decode_from_codes / encode and no streaming entry point, and the model holds no cache attribute

**`dualcodec_25hz_v1`** — Inference.decode('semantic_codes', 'acoustic_codes') carries no state parameter; the module exposes decode / decode_from_codes / encode and no streaming entry point, and the model holds no cache attribute

**`qwen3_tts_tokenizer_12hz`** — the public tokenizer API exposes encode/decode only; there is no state argument and no streaming entry point on the decode path. The documented causal ConvNet is architectural evidence and is not promoted to a capability (R13).

**`fish_modified_dac`** — decode('indices', 'feature_lengths') takes no state parameter. KV-cache machinery exists in the module tree (KVCache, setup_caches, clear_cache, use_kv_cache default False) but setup_caches() is never called on this path and 0 KVCache modules are instantiated, so no cache is live and none is threaded through decode().

**`melflow`** — CausalNCSNpp implements CausalStreamingModule: init_state() plus forward_step(x, time_cond, aux_condition, *, state), and 137 submodules implement that interface. One state list is carried per solver step (5 euler steps per frame). The repository ships no streaming driver; this one was written against that contract.

**`vocos_mel24`** — ConvNeXt backbone with centre padding and an iSTFT head; no state argument on decode()

**`bigvgan22`** — anti-aliased transposed-convolution generator; forward() takes a mel tensor and no state of any kind

**`griffinlim`** — iterative phase reconstruction over the whole spectrogram; no state of any kind on the decode path. THIS ROW RAN WITH rand_init=False and is deterministic — measured self-vs-self error 0.000e+00 (see determinism_probe). The torchaudio default rand_init=True is NOT a function of its input (self-vs-self 7.7404e-01 / 131.3% with no chunking at all) and that configuration is WITHDRAWN; PROTOCOL amendment 4.

**`nanocodec`** — NOT MEASURED - arm not runnable

## Commentary — written by hand, NOT measured

*Everything above this heading is read from a run artifact. Everything below is interpretation.*

**`melflow`** — **KEEP, with its label scope corrected — do not rerun and do not withdraw.** The measurement is correct and was independently reproduced to the digit (stateful `3.036112e-06`), determinism is exact in both directions, and the carried state was shown load-bearing by four independent attacks (zeroed state, stale state, reset-every-5, reset-every-25, plus permuted frames at ~1800× baseline). What was wrong was the SCOPE of the label, not the number. The stateful error is identical at all four rows because the stateful branch is ONE continuous 16 ms-granularity stream that is merely sliced — **C1 holds at one-frame granularity only**, and 5/10/25/50 are state-RESET intervals for the stateless null. For the same reason the length-drift decomposition does not apply: the decoder emits spectrogram frames and the inverse STFT is run once over the assembled spectrogram, so there is no per-chunk length accumulation to measure. **To earn an unqualified label this arm needs a streaming overlap-add stage that is written AND tested** — the delta audit's control shows naive chunking of that stage fails at 134.65%, so it may not be inferred (R13).

**`focalcodec_50hz_65k_causal`** — POST-FREEZE ARM, DECLARED 2026-09-11 (PROTOCOL amendment 3). Where one causal FocalCodec configuration must be named, that is `focalcodec_50hz_4k_causal`, which was frozen in PROTOCOL §3 before any result existed.

**`griffinlim`** — Run with `rand_init=False` (PROTOCOL amendment 4). With torchaudio's default `rand_init=True` and no seed, self-vs-self error with NO chunking at all was 7.7404e-01 / 131.3% — larger than the chunking number it was reported as. R9 zero-parameter floor, never a production candidate.

**`mimi_q32`** — SENSITIVITY ABLATION ONLY. Never merged with `mimi_q8`, and n_q=32 is never described as 'Mimi 1.1 kbps' — that figure belongs to n_q=8.
